contracts.generation: FILE READ enables cooperative Pythonic generation; source destinations and format expressions are captured once before waiting; legacy strict emission stays internal
contracts.streaming_text: Explicit TextInput(final=False) distinguishes incomplete input from completed invalid fields using TextInputIncomplete; default final=True preserves existing parsing

keyboard.input: Injected printable events submit bounded editable lines on ENTER; ordinary scalar formats and CR parse retained pending text
keyboard.publication: Complete response validation before any target writes or committed cursor movement; retain buffered suffixes and record one source-read observation
keyboard.lifetime: Existing pane ownership, echo/noecho, suspension, finite IDs/history and finally cleanup; close idle handles before saving
keyboard.boundaries: No host input, native keys, generic PASSALL/custom-EOL/binary/XML transfer or widget/timing equivalence

pipes.input: Explicit ATR_PIPWAIT WAIT_USED polls cooperatively in logical10ms steps; WAIT_NOTUSED captures an end boundary; no attributes preserves legacy immediate reads
pipes.overflow: Explicit OVF_EOF latches failure until reopen; byte advances are capacity checked and rounded upward to configured record_size after unread data loss
pipes.publication: Probe complete text/binary requests before source writes/cursor advancement; snapshot queries/seeks respect the captured end
pipes.standalone: Pending waits require explicit injected sleeper provenance, retained across source linkage; no default indefinite host sleep
pipes.boundaries: No automatic producer, native formatted dictionary display, native default reconciliation, physical pipe transport or suspended-handle persistence

historical_notes: Supersedes older blanket generic keyboard FILE READ and plain-pipe wait/snapshot exclusions. Historical per-feature ledger versions remain preserved.
